items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: Now Chris and I, we practice a lot together

ctx.x: I was going to ask you about different tunes that you like in particular.

Well it all depends on how you feel, Dick. When your lip is right you like the ones you're going to show off and not make any clinkers. But there's a lot of good tunes, Dick. Now Chris and I, we practice a lot together and Chris likes Wolverine blues. And Chris likes Big Bud and Eggman the way we play it. And he knocks hell out of the Hindu stand. But that's a crip. That's as easy as the Saints. And I used to really like Deed I Do. It's a Tin Pan Alley tune, but I always did like it. Sleepy down the South I…
What about She's Crying for Me? Why did you ever pick that tune up?
